name: ✦ Worlds Hardest Game
desc:
All data saves! 
Note: level 31 is possible, you just have to get over it.

Premium Benefits: - You get a free stage skip every 20 minutes!

Using gamepasses or skips prevents you from getting badges, this is indicated with a red outline on the skip button!

Changelog: 
- 10 New Skins
- Achievements
- Many Bugfixes
- New Easter Egg
- Completionist achievement for getting all the badges, unlocks the RGB skin and gives u all gamepasses for free!!

Available in server versions 1151+

Level editor coming soon! 

Original game was made by Snubby
